_about: Vocabulary confirmed by the supplied material. Each row names the evidence it rests on. Nothing here is inferred from general knowledge of the franchise.

evidence.sourceText: Ratings include S, SS, SSS, SR, SSR, with extensible categories.

ratings.orderNote: sortOrder is the order in which the client listed the ranks (D to SSR). It is a display order only: no ranking power hierarchy has been defined.

evidenceM3.sourceText: D, C, B-, B, B+, A-, A, A+, S-, S, S+, SS, SSS, SR, SSR.

guideStatistics._about: Stat terms exactly as the status guide words them. They are kept apart even when two may be the same stat (e.g. 'final damage' and 'final damage dealt'); merging is the client's call.

rows.name: defenses
rows.note: Plural group term as written in the guide. Which defenses it covers (physical, strategy, both) is not stated.

rows.name: final damage
rows.note: As written under Dispirited State. May or may not be the same stat as 'final damage dealt'.

rows.name: final damage dealt
rows.note: As written under Pyroblast state and Fury Shield. May or may not be the same stat as 'final damage'.

formations._about: In-game positions. English names: 'Support' is printed on the ninja card; 'Center' and 'Vanguard' are the client's wording. Spanish names are printed on the in-game formation screen. «Assaulter» is the label printed on cards; it is kept as its own row with a PROPOSED equivalence to Center, so no card label is rewritten and no rule of Center is applied to it until the client confirms.

evidenceRule.sourceText: Support, Center, Vanguard describe formation positions (rear, middle, front). All Support units primarily use Chakra; Center/Vanguard primarily use Force. Future teams contain four ninjas; max 3 Support, 2 Center, 1 Vanguard.

rows.name: Assaulter
rows.equivalenceNote: Confirmado por el cliente: «Assaulter» y «Center» son la misma posición de formación. La ficha conserva su etiqueta original y se aplican las reglas de Centro (fuerza como estadística principal, máximo 2 por equipo).

equivalenceEvidence.sourceText: Assaulter = Center. They represent the same formation position.

roles._about: Source categories: the channels of the reference material a ninja is filed under. They are NOT the in-game formation. A mapping to a formation is a PROPOSAL until the client approves it; a ninja's formation is otherwise taken only from its own card.

rows.name: supporters
rows.mappingNote: Las 17 fichas entregadas de este canal imprimen «Formation: Support». Falta la confirmación del cliente para aplicarlo a los ninjas sin ficha.

rows.name: assaulters
rows.mappingNote: Confirmado por el cliente: Assaulter = Center. Las 58 fichas entregadas de este canal imprimen «Formation: Assaulter» (中坚 en las fichas en chino).

evidence.sourceText: Assaulter = Center. They represent the same formation position.

rows.name: vanguards
rows.mappingNote: Las 28 fichas entregadas de este canal imprimen «Formation: Vanguard» (先锋 en la ficha en chino, Avant-garde en la francesa). Falta la confirmación del cliente para aplicarlo a los ninjas sin ficha.

evidence.sourceText: The Discord channels are named supporters, assaulters, vanguards

rows.name: alien-ninjas
rows.mappingNote: Colección aparte de la lista de lanzamientos. No corresponde a una formación: cada ficha imprime la suya.

evidence.sourceText: Alien Ninjas,10,complete,separate category from 167-month release roster

rows.name: awakening-ninjas
rows.mappingNote: Canal de despertares. No corresponde a una formación.

evidence.sourceText: Awakening Ninjas,7,complete,overlaps with two formation channels

statusCategories._about: Structural facets used to classify dictionary entries. Spanish labels are interface wording, not game terms.
